title: SatCompute TaskTrace 0.1
description: Closed-world input-transfer, compute, and result-transfer workload for one scenario.

schema_version.description: TaskTrace contract version; version 0.1 is required by this schema.

tasks.description: Non-empty task set; array order has no semantic effect.

task.description: One task whose input is transferred to a compute satellite and whose result is transferred onward.

task_id.description: Positive unique uint64 ID no greater than UINT64_MAX/2; input and result transfer IDs are derived as 2*task_id-1 and 2*task_id.

source_node_id.description: External uint32 satellite ID holding the input; it must differ from compute_node_id.

compute_node_id.description: External uint32 satellite ID that must appear in ComputeProfile and differ from both transfer peers.

result_node_id.description: External uint32 satellite ID receiving the result; it may equal source_node_id but not compute_node_id.

input_bytes.description: Positive application bytes transferred from source_node_id to compute_node_id.

output_bytes.description: Positive application bytes transferred from compute_node_id to result_node_id after compute completion.

compute_work_units.description: Positive abstract work consumed by the non-preemptive compute service.

arrival_time_ns.description: Non-negative integer-ns task arrival offset that precedes simulation stop.
